summary: A clearing continuation initially treated three visible but unenrolled cards without Status as outside its pass; the user identified the omission. Canonical work-board intake must examine unfiltered All items, including missing Status/Work level/enrollment. Reconcile native scope, full acceptance, ownership, prerequisites and evidence; record accepted completion, eligible work, concrete blocker/supplier or attributed Unknown in the existing owning issue. Unfinished intake needs an accountable intake owner, next action and reconsideration event. Missing Status is a triage trigger, never a selection filter. Actual bounded108 triage initialized12previously absent metadata values on three existing cards: two completed source promises Done/Active delivery and one open producer-dependent request Blocked/Follow-up, each explicitly Delivery with genuine owning links. Separate original-custody readback/full snapshot comparison preserves17fields/eightviews/25memberships and unrelated native/planning values; no enrollment, membership, view, Observation or implementation dispatch changed. The open request retains complete original acceptance and Programme/root intake ownership until actual producer evidence and implementation enrollment are selected. A complete fresh census observes zero missing Status. Planning/classification repair is not protected enrollment or Ready authority; preserve existing human values and never schedule an unenrolled card. No new intake queue or ledger is needed. This is finite operational/source guidance acceptance, not fleet adoption or a promise that all future metadata is automatically repaired.
title: Visible missing-Status and unenrolled cards require accountable intake triage
